products.name: Portable Cable Organizer / Winder
products.description:
Loose cords get annoying fast. This made-to-order 3D printed cable winder keeps chargers, earbuds, USB-C cords, and small desk cables wrapped neatly so they are easier to toss in a bag, drawer, nightstand, or travel kit. Choose Small, Medium, or Large depending on the cable you want to tame — or grab all three sizes as a bundle.

Size guide:
• Small — best for earbuds, short USB-C/Lightning cables, and compact travel cords
• Medium — best everyday size for phone chargers and small accessory cables
• Large — best for longer or thicker charging cords

Made to order in PLA in our small US shop. Please allow 3-7 business days for production before shipping. Slight layer lines are normal for 3D printed items, and cable is not included.

Design attribution: original Portable Cable Organizer / Winder model by Squinn on MakerWorld, used under CC BY with attribution.
